slides.alt: A kitchen stove with a grey Dutch oven of browning rooster pieces and onion, a pan of diced zucchini, a jar of zarzavat, a glass of frozen dill and a small bowl of parsley on a wooden board.
A hand holding a jar of golden chicken schmalz with a handwritten label in a kitchen.
A hand holding a jar of red-orange homemade zarzavat labelled "Mama's Zarzavat" in front of a window and a snake plant.
A table from above with a plate of rooster stew with rice and zucchini, a bowl of pickled cucumbers, a jar of pickles, a bowl of stew and a small dish of salt on a leaf-patterned tablecloth.
A close-up of a nearly finished bowl of creamy rooster stew with rice, zucchini and dill, a spoon in the bowl and a chicken bone at the side.
